rows.grounds: compound indicating the limit of time, up to the end of worship
object of the prohibition; vessel holding the arghya water
prescribes the prohibited action regarding the vessel

items.question: For how long must the arghya vessel remain unmoved during the ritual sequence?
premises: The ritual period extends until the completion of worship.
The arghya vessel is present as a ritual object during this period.
The prescribed rule prohibits moving the arghya vessel.
items.inference: Therefore, the arghya vessel must remain unmoved until the worship is completed.
items.plain_english: The practitioner should not move the arghya vessel until the completion of the worship.
